core_obligations: Reduce to affine S and to representability on affine schemes over S, and set up the induction on the length n of the complete devissage with the strictly decreasing sequence of relative dimensions d_1 > ... > d_n >= 0 (proof lines 7822-7846).

Use that F = i_{1,*}G_1 with i_1 a closed immersion, and that pi_1 : Z_1 -> Y_1 is finite, to show that flatness in dimensions at least d of F_T is equivalent to flatness in dimensions at least d of pi_{1,*}G_{1,T}, and in particular that pi_{1,*}G_1 is flat over S in dimensions at least d+1 (proof lines 7849-7862).

For d_1 > d: make alpha_1 S-universally injective after shrinking S, write the short exact sequence 0 -> O_{Y_{1,T}}^{r_1} -> pi_{1,T,*}G_{1,T} -> Coker(alpha_1)_T -> 0 with universally injective first arrow, deduce that the flatness loci of pi_{1,T,*}G_{1,T} and of Coker(alpha_1)_T coincide, and conclude by induction on n applied to the cokernel (proof lines 7864-7882).
Dispose of the remaining cases: if d_1 < d then F_d is represented by S itself, and if d_1 = d the conclusion follows from the comparison and generic-freeness lemmas (proof lines 7884-7891).
proof_roadmap: Set up the induction on the devissage length and the strictly decreasing dimensions (proof lines 7822-7846).
Reduce flatness of F functorially to flatness of the finite pushforward along the first step of the devissage (proof lines 7849-7862).
Reduce the main case to the cokernel of alpha_1 and finish by induction, treating the two boundary cases separately (proof lines 7864-7891).
difficulty_reason: In the flatness-in-dimension-n situation, assuming a complete devissage of F/X/S over a point s, finite presentation of X over S and of F over X, and flatness in dimensions at least d+1, the lemma asserts that after shrinking S the functor F_d is representable by a monomorphism Z_d -> S of finite presentation (statement lines 7805-7819). The proof runs an induction on the length n of the devissage, whose relative dimensions satisfy d_1 > d_2 > ... > d_n >= 0 because each alpha_k is an isomorphism at the generic point of (Y_k)_s. The key reductions are functorial: since F = i_{1,*}G_1 for a closed immersion i_1 and since pi_1 : Z_1 -> Y_1 is finite, flatness in dimensions at least d of F_T is equivalent to flatness in dimensions at least d of pi_{1,*}G_{1,T} (proof lines 7849-7862). When d_1 > d the author uses the induction-step lemma to make alpha_1 S-universally injective after shrinking, obtains the short exact sequence 0 -> O_{Y_{1,T}}^{r_1} -> pi_{1,T,*}G_{1,T} -> Coker(alpha_1)_T -> 0 with a universally injective first arrow, identifies the flatness loci of the two outer terms, and reduces to Coker(alpha_1), which carries a complete devissage of length n - 1 (proof lines 7864-7882); the case d_1 < d is represented by S itself, and the boundary case d_1 = d is quoted from two further lemmas (proof lines 7884-7891). The functorial reduction along a finite and a closed immersion, and the exact reduction of the flatness locus to the cokernel, are the non-formal content, so the claim is H2.
